purpose: Verify an executable second-family MEC threshold geometry before any learned-world-model or hidden cross-family run.
predecessor_fact: Old IDP mechanical-reference-vs-encoder construction was development-disqualified because the mechanical reference perturbation changed physical rollout semantics.

static.name: IDP_CART_ORIGIN_VS_SENSOR_ZERO
static.world_A: physical cart origin/home displacement c with unbiased sensor
static.world_B: nominal physical cart position with cart-position sensor zero offset c
static.same_channel_requirement: open-loop observed generalized state trajectories must match below the independent physical-reference probe
static.resolving_probe: independent world/track position reference reveals physical cart displacement

dynamic.name: IDP_CART_DAMPING_VS_ACTUATOR_BIAS
dynamic.world_B: fixed cart actuator bias chosen to match the damping perturbation at velocity b
dynamic.D2: add second point v=b+a while keeping the same actuator bias

future_hidden_commitment.derivation: SHA256(protocol_id|tag) deterministic seed derivation; no result-dependent seed selection.

if_preflight_fails: Do not train cross-family WMs and do not use future hidden seeds. Preserve this failure and redesign under a new protocol ID.
if_preflight_passes: Authorize only a development learned-world-model cross-family qualification. Hidden remains prohibited until that later development protocol passes.
